label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I q.46 a.2…: An infinite regress is impossible among efficient…
locator: I q.46 a.2 ad 7: in causis efficientibus impossibile est procedere in infinitum per se ... Sed per accidens in infinitum procedere in causis agentibus non reputatur impossibile
interpretation: Aquinas' own restriction of the regress principle to per se ordered causes, using the prima via's stone, stick and hand example. It supports restricting STMT-NO-INFINITE-PER-SE-MOVER-SERIES to per se links, which both readings of the per se premise share. Context: the reply answers an objection that an eternal world implies an infinite series of fathers.
